def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    bar=None
    for c in cols:
        for r in g:
            j=0
            while j<w:
                if r[j]==c:
                    k=j
                    while k<w and r[k]==c: k+=1
                    if k-j>=2: bar=c
                    j=k
                else: j+=1
    line=[c for c in cols if c!=bar][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==line]
    n=len(cells)
    bars=[]
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if g[i][j]==bar:
                k=j
                while k<w and g[i][k]==bar: k+=1
                if k-j>=2: bars.append((i,j,k-1))
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (i,j0,j1) in bars:
        band=(j1-n+1, j1)
        step=1 if i==0 else -1
        for j in range(band[0],band[1]+1):
            ii=i+step
            while 0<=ii<h and g[ii][j]!=line:
                if out[ii][j]==bg: out[ii][j]=line
                ii+=step
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=4
    return out
